info.name: Arduino IoT Cloud binaries_v2 usage_v1 API

params.name: device_id
params.description: Optional: restrict results to this device

params.name: thing_id
params.description: Optional: restrict results to this thing

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, inclusive (UTC). Must be >= from. Max range: 400 days.

items.docs: Returns the daily message-consumption series for the authenticated user or the organization (when X-Organization is set). One data point per day.

params.name: device_id
params.description: Optional: restrict results to this device

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the range, inclusive. Truncated to the beginning of the month (UTC).

params.name: thing_id
params.description: Optional: restrict results to this thing

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, inclusive. Truncated to the end of the month (UTC). Max range: 5 years.

items.docs: Returns the monthly message-consumption series for the authenticated user or the organization (when X-Organization is set). One data point per calendar month (UTC).

params.name: thing_id
params.description: Optional: restrict results to this thing

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, inclusive (UTC). Must be >= from. Max range: 400 days.

items.docs: Returns the daily message-consumption series broken down per thing for the authenticated user or the organization (when X-Organization is set). When thing_id is set the response contains a single thing entry. Devices belonging to the same thing are summed together.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the range, inclusive. Truncated to the beginning of the month (UTC).

params.name: thing_id
params.description: Optional: restrict results to this thing

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, inclusive. Truncated to the end of the month (UTC). Max range: 5 years.

items.docs: Returns the monthly message-consumption series broken down per thing for the authenticated user or the organization (when X-Organization is set). When thing_id is set the response contains a single thing entry. Devices belonging to the same thing are summed together.
